author: Eric Skovan
text:
Call the 800 number. They'll ask a few short questions and send you a new one. They may also send a return box for your old one.

If you haven't thrown the applicator and box away yet keep them, they'll want you to return them too.

author: 匿名互动者 125
text: I always keep the box and applicator until I start a new one. It just came in handy as mine failed.
